bulk.most: A decision takes at most 100 comments at once.

skipped.one: {n} was not in a state that action changes, and was left as it was.
skipped.other: {n} were not in a state that action changes, and were left as they were.

said.locked: The thread is locked: nobody can comment on it until an admin unlocks it.

list.pickAll: Select every comment shown, up to 100

empty.held: Nothing is waiting. A comment with a link or a listed word lands here.
empty.reported: No live or held comment has a report.

list.moreFailed: The next page did not load. Try again.
list.phone: Open the desk on a wider screen to act on a comment.

detail.none: Pick a comment to read it in its thread.
detail.threadFailed: The thread did not load, so the comment is shown alone.
detail.threadFar: The comment it hangs under is further back in the thread.
detail.author: The author
detail.authorFailed: The author's counts did not load.

words.title: Listed words
words.addLabel: A word or phrase to list
words.empty: No word is listed. Only a link holds a comment.
words.foot: A comment carrying one of these, or a link, waits for an admin. A change applies to the next comment, never to the ones already through.

said.word_invalid: A listed word is letters and digits, with single spaces, hyphens or apostrophes, up to 40 characters.
said.unknown_word: That word was already off the list.
said.ids_invalid: Pick between 1 and 100 comments, then try again.
said.action_invalid: Soma did not know that action. Reload the page and try again.
said.reason_too_long: A reason is up to 300 characters. Shorten it and try again.
said.host_required: The thread could not be named. Reload the page and try again.
said.admin_only: You are no longer an admin.

refusals.unreachable: The API did not answer; nothing changed.
